release_notes: TRUE incremental sync via $$LastAlterId + $ALTERID filter (matches BizAnalyst behaviour). Catches same-day adds, edits to old vouchers, and back-dated entries — none missed. Plus three layers of safety: (1) read-only XML validator refuses to send any write request to Tally; (2) per-process request lock serialises concurrent Tally calls; (3) the v9.8.21 single-instance lock prevents two .exe copies. LVD remains as a fallback when AlterID is unsupported.
